segments.text: Wanwan, did you hear that?
Mo Xue is going back to her country!
He didn't just hear that you and Huo Mianxi are getting married, right?
Go back and come back. It has nothing to do with me.
How does it have nothing to do with me?
Back then, Huo Mianxi was doing it for him.
He almost got into a fight with his family.
Okay, Qiao Qiao.
Mo Xue has already been in the past for Mianxi.
I'll hang up now.
Miss Mo, this way please.
Hey, you lost.
Please help me think about how to save Huo Shao.
Thank you.
Why don't you call the girl you love the most in your life, Huo Shao?
I'm not married yet. Don't make any trouble.
I think it's better to have another one.
It's okay.
I'm willing to accept it.
It's okay.
I just heard that you're going back to your country.
I want to ask you how you've been doing lately.
Can you give me a chance to meet you?
Marry?
You clearly know who I like.
I'm his family member.
I have nothing to do with him.
I'm his family member.
I have nothing to do with him.
I can give him the name Huo Shao.
But he can't be in love.
I only have my heart.
What are you doing here?
I'm the only one on the team today. Don't you know that?
We're getting married tomorrow anyway.
Do you have any sense?
I didn't tell you to come here.
I think you've drunk too much. So...
It's okay.
Let's continue.
Let's not break the rules today.
